en.title: Outback Steakhouse Serves Up Thor's Hammer Steak for Marvel Fans
en.summary: Prepare to wield your appetite like the God of Thunder. Outback Steakhouse has unveiled a colossal steak shaped like Thor's iconic hammer, Mjolnir, as part of a new Avengers-themed menu.
en.body:
The culinary world is no stranger to thematic collaborations, and the latest partnership between **Outback Steakhouse** and the **Avengers: Doomsday** franchise is a particularly mighty one. In a move that’s sure to delight Marvel enthusiasts and foodies alike, the steakhouse chain has revealed a massive, Mjolnir-inspired steak, a dish that perfectly captures the essence of Thor's legendary hammer.

This isn't just any steak; it's a culinary recreation of one of the most recognizable weapons in comic book history. The star of the **Outback Steakhouse Korea** limited-edition menu features a hefty cut of beef, ingeniously utilizing its bone to form the distinct handle of Thor's hammer. This creative presentation transforms a meal into an experience, allowing fans to literally get their hands on a piece of the Marvel universe. The collaboration is set to officially launch on November 10th, with further details about other menu items still under wraps.

## A Feast Fit for a God of Thunder

While **Outback Steakhouse** is making a significant splash with its hammer-shaped steak, they are not the only ones joining the **Avengers: Doomsday** marketing frenzy. Competitors like **KFC** and **Jack in the Box** have also announced their own themed menus and collectible tie-ins, indicating a widespread effort to capture the excitement surrounding the franchise. The specific details of **Outback**'s full menu remain a mystery, but the initial reveal of the **Thor's Hammer Steak** has certainly set a high bar for creativity and fan engagement. This initiative demonstrates a keen understanding of how to leverage popular culture to create buzz and offer unique experiences that resonate with a passionate fanbase.

## Community Reaction and Anticipation

News of the **Thor’s Hammer Steak** has quickly spread across social media and fan forums, igniting a wave of enthusiasm. Fans are expressing their excitement about the sheer novelty and cleverness of the concept. The idea of eating a steak that so closely resembles Mjolnir has generated considerable chatter, with many eager to see the full menu and share their own dining experiences. The **Outback Steakhouse Korea** Instagram page has been a focal point for these discussions, with users speculating about the steak's size, taste, and the other dishes that might accompany it. This kind of fan engagement is precisely what these marketing collaborations aim to achieve, turning a simple meal into a shared cultural moment.

## What's Next for the Avengers Menu

With the official launch date of November 10th approaching, fans are eagerly awaiting more information from **Outback Steakhouse**. While the **Thor's Hammer Steak** is the undeniable centerpiece, the promise of additional menu items, including a pasta dish and other unspecified items teased on social media, keeps the anticipation high. It will be interesting to see how these other offerings tie into the broader **Avengers: Doomsday** theme and whether they can match the immediate impact of the Mjolnir-inspired steak.

content_raw: Outback Steakhouse is the latest chain to join the Avengers: Doomsday food craze with an enormous steak inspired by Thor’s hammer.
